external_entities.name: Shopper
external_entities.description: A shopper who browses the storefront, signs in, and places orders.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Shoppers browse the storefront and place orders

external_entities.name: card processor
external_entities.description: A third-party card processor that settles payments and sends payment webhooks.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our card processor is a third party.

processes.name: storefront API
processes.description: A Node service running on Cloud Run that shoppers use to browse and place orders and that receives payment webhooks.
processes.source_excerpt: the storefront API, a Node service running on Cloud Run
processes.technology: Node service running on Cloud Run

processes.name: order service
processes.description: A Python worker in the core network that processes orders, reads and writes the orders database, and writes completed-order receipts.
processes.source_excerpt: The order service is a Python worker in our core network

data_stores.name: orders-db
data_stores.description: A PostgreSQL database containing orders, shopper addresses, and card-last-four data.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Orders, shopper addresses and card-last-four live in a PostgreSQL database (orders-db)

data_stores.name: receipt archive
data_stores.description: A Cloud Storage bucket containing receipts for completed orders, including which order was written and that the order service wrote it.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a Cloud Storage bucket we call the receipt archive

data_flows.name: browse and place orders
data_flows.description: Shopper interaction with the storefront for browsing, sign-in, and order placement.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Shoppers browse the storefront and place orders through the storefront API
data_flows.authentication: email and password with a session cookie; MFA not rolled out
data_flows.data_description: Browsing, shopper sign-in, and order placement

data_flows.name: order submission
data_flows.description: The storefront API calls the order service when a shopper submits an order.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When a shopper submits an order the storefront API calls the order service over gRPC.

data_flows.name: order data access
data_flows.description: The order service reads and writes orders, shopper addresses, and card-last-four in the database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the order service reads and writes with a single application account that has full read/write
data_flows.authentication: single application account; password from an environment variable on the worker

data_flows.name: receipt writing
data_flows.description: The order service writes a receipt for every completed order to the receipt archive.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every completed order also gets a receipt written to a Cloud Storage bucket we call the receipt archive.
data_flows.data_description: Receipt recording which order was written and that the order service wrote it

data_flows.name: payment webhook
data_flows.description: The card processor sends a webhook to the storefront API after settling a payment to report that the order is paid.
data_flows.source_excerpt: After they settle a payment they POST a webhook back to the storefront API to tell us the order is paid.
data_flows.notes: The source states: "I would have to check how that callback is authenticated."

trust_boundaries.name: internet
trust_boundaries.description: The internet-facing environment from which shoppers reach the storefront.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: It is the only thing we expose to the internet.

trust_boundaries.name: Cloud Run
trust_boundaries.description: The Cloud Run hosting environment for the storefront API.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: a Node service running on Cloud Run

trust_boundaries.name: core network
trust_boundaries.description: The organisation's core network containing the order service and orders database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The order service is a Python worker in our core network

trust_boundaries.name: Cloud Storage
trust_boundaries.description: The Cloud Storage hosting environment containing the receipt archive.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: a Cloud Storage bucket we call the receipt archive

trust_boundaries.name: third party
trust_boundaries.description: The external-party zone containing the third-party card processor.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our card processor is a third party.

assumptions.assumption: The storefront API presents a web interface because it is described as a storefront used by shoppers to browse and place orders.
assumptions.basis: The source describes shoppers browsing the storefront and placing orders through the storefront API.

assumptions.assumption: The orders database is confidential because it contains shopper addresses and card-last-four data.
assumptions.basis: The source states that orders-db contains shopper addresses and card-last-four data.

assumptions.assumption: The receipt archive is confidential because it contains completed-order receipts and payment-related order records.
assumptions.basis: The source states that completed orders produce receipts and that the receipt records the order written.
